args.question: I can't switch to your existing Netflix tab — I can only control this tab. Should I open Netflix in this tab instead?
options: Yes, open Netflix in this tab
args.reason: I have no tool to activate or enumerate other tabs, so I need to know whether opening Netflix here is acceptable.

content: I can't switch to or activate another browser tab — I can only control the current tab (which is a New Tab page right now). Your Netflix tab's state (profile, what you were watching) would be lost if I just opened netflix.com here.
